name: Reeb Graph
aliases: Contour Graph / Contour Tree / Hyper Reeb Graph
definition: A generalisation of the contour tree that computes the topology of scalar data in domains that are not simply connected (contain loops) or lack a boundary.
summary: The Reeb graph is a topological data structure that captures the topology of scalar fields on domains with loops or missing boundaries, distinguishing itself from contour trees by handling non-simply connected spaces.
